description: Grain is an AI meeting recording and note-taking platform with a REST API for recordings, transcripts, and sharing.
access_notes: Personal Access Tokens are self-generated per-user from account integration settings; Workspace Access Tokens are self-generated by authorized workspace users. No explicit plan-gating documented.
api_notes: Recordings (list/retrieve/download/upload/update), transcripts, sharing/collaboration, webhooks, users/teams metadata, and AI-generated summaries and action items.
